Callout.Name: Stranded Motorist - Welfare Check
Callout.Message: Motorist stranded with no fuel in freezing weather.
Callout.Advisory: Person in a car with the engine off.

Script.Line: I ran out three miles back and coasted to here.
There is no phone signal in this valley. There never is.
I have been sat an hour with the engine off to save the battery.

Lines.Approach: The engine is off and it is well below freezing. That is somebody in trouble, not a parking problem.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
